description: Find lookalike domains of a brand's website: typos, swapped letters, look-alike characters, added words and other TLDs. Checks which of them resolve in DNS and what their front page shows (a page using the brand's name, a redirect to the brand's own site, another live site, or nothing). Read-only. Same check as https://openbait.com/tools/typosquat-check.

domain.description: the brand's website, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com

name: check_lookalike_domains

domain.description: the registrable domain that was checked

mutationType.description: homoglyph, keyword, omission, transposition or tld_swap

score.description: 0-100, higher is more likely to be mistaken for the brand

site.description: for names that resolve: brand_page (page uses the brand's name), redirects_to_you (ends on the brand's own domain), live_other or no_site

title: Check lookalike domains
